map.消防演练策划中，随机生成演练场景（火点、被困、险情联动），训练响应流程与分工。: In fire drill planning, drill scenarios (fire point, trapped persons, hazard linkage) are generated randomly to train the response process and role division.
map.按单位类型（商场/工厂/办公）定制情景，覆盖报警、疏散、扑救、联动各环节。: Scenarios are tailored by unit type (mall / factory / office), covering the alarm, evacuation, firefighting and linkage links.
map.演练后复盘用时与处置正确性，迭代优化应急预案。: After the drill, review the elapsed time and handling correctness to iteratively optimise the emergency plan.
map.示例：生成一次综合演练场景: Example: generating a comprehensive drill scenario
map.点击生成后获得随机情景卡（如『2 层仓库电气起火，1 人被困，需联动排烟与广播』: After clicking generate you get a random scenario card (such as 'electrical fire on the 2nd floor of a warehouse, 1 person trapped, smoke exhaust and broadcast linkage required'), execute alarm -> evacuation -> initial firefighting -> linkage per the card, and record the elapsed time of each link.
map.将场景按指挥、报警、疏散引导、灭火行动、救护分工，逐项核对到位情况；未到位项列入: Break the scenario down by command, alarm, evacuation guiding, firefighting action and first aid, and check the arrival status item by item; items not in place go into rectification and become the focus of the next drill.
map.演练场景可以完全随机吗？: Can the drill scenarios be fully random?
map.随机用于训练应变，但应受控在预案覆盖范围内，并兼顾单位真实风险点。建议固定高风险: Randomness is useful for training adaptability, but it should be controlled within the coverage of the plan and also consider the unit's real risk points. A fixed high-risk scenario plus random perturbations is recommended, training both proficiency and unexpected handling.
map.演练频次有要求吗？: Is there a requirement for drill frequency?
map.多数场所要求至少每年一次综合演练、每半年一次专项/桌面推演（以最新法规与单位制度: Most premises require at least one comprehensive drill per year and a special or tabletop exercise every six months (subject to the latest regulations and the unit's own system). High frequency with review is better than low frequency as a formality.
